summary: Pye was a Nomai from Ember Twin who confirmed the negative time interval at the High Energy Lab and co-designed the Sun Station with Idaea. She died on the Interloper, choosing to stay behind to study its lethal exotic-matter core while ordering Poke to flee with the warning.

behavior: Pye is initially skeptical of unprecedented findings and considers them equipment errors before being convinced.
Pye favors pushing technology further than ever before, calling it the defining characteristic of the Nomai species.
Pye enjoys word puns and makes light of grim subjects, including jokes about the Sun exploding.
Pye argues frequently with Idaea over the ethics of the Sun Station.
Pye has a friendly joking relationship with Ramie, exchanging gas-themed puns.
Pye sacrificed herself on the Interloper, choosing to stay and learn about the alien matter while ordering Poke to escape and warn the Nomai.
location: Pye originally lived in the Sunless City on Ember Twin.
Pye worked at the High Energy Lab on Ember Twin with Ramie.
Pye and Idaea worked at the Sun Station to construct it.
Pye went to the Interloper with Poke and Clary after the Sun Station's failure.
Pye's corpse can be found near the ruptured core of the Interloper, close to her last recording.
lore: Pye is a member of the Nomai.
Pye is the aunt of Laevi and Lami.
Pye studied the Anglerfish fossil in the Sunless City at some point.
Pye told Laevi and Lami that real Anglerfish are blind, leading them to add a blindfold rule to their anglerfish game.
Pye and Ramie reviewed Poke's records of the negative time interval at the warp between White Hole Station and Brittle Hollow.
Pye initially considered the negative time interval impossible, stating the implications would be absurd.
Pye and Ramie designed an experiment at the High Energy Lab to recreate the negative time anomaly.
Pye remained skeptical even after the first experiment reproduced the anomaly, suspecting equipment error.
Pye and Ramie strengthened the effect by rerouting energy from the Sunless City to the experiment.
Pye confirmed the existence of the negative time interval after the energy-boosted experiment.
Pye determined that creating a 22-minute interval was theoretically possible but required exponentially more energy and advanced warp technology.
Pye argued that fitting the new energy and warp technologies together required an enormous space, with Ash Twin being the only suitable candidate.
Pye proposed warp towers as the way to travel quickly between Ash Twin and crucial Ash Twin Project locations.
Pye disagreed with Idaea's ethical opposition to the Sun Station, arguing the Nomai must push technology further than ever before.
Pye believed there was no other practical way to generate supernova-level power within the Nomai's lifetimes.
Pye and Idaea built the Sun Station together despite their constant disagreements.
Pye computed shuttle trajectories to the Sun Station as a 'purely theoretical exercise' even though the warp was the only intended route.
Pye wrote the Sun Station's mission statement: 'Science compels us to explode the sun.'
Pye accused Idaea of lacking a sense of humor when he objected to the morbid mission statement.
Pye argued the mission statement was accurate since they were creating a supernova for scientific progress.
Yarrow proposed time away from the Sun Station for both Pye and Idaea, which they agreed with.
Pye was 'beside herself with joy' when the Advanced Warp Core was finished.
Pye's mood changed quickly when the Sun Station fired but caused only infinitesimal surface-level changes on the Sun.
Pye declared the Sun Station useless and incapable of ever causing the Sun to explode.
Pye believed redesigning the Sun Station was still the only viable option, since supernova-level power required a supernova.
Pye noted that waiting for the Sun's natural supernova would require halting the Nomai aging process.
Spire spotted the Interloper approaching the star system, which Yarrow asked Pye to investigate.
On the Interloper, Pye and Poke descended through an ice fissure on the sunward side to investigate strange energy readings.
Pye determined the Interloper's exotic matter was disturbingly volatile and protected only by an unfamiliar stone casing.
Pye recognized the lethal matter would expand to blanket the star system if the casing ruptured.
Pye ordered Poke back to the shuttle and stayed behind to learn more about the alien matter.
Pye reasoned that the more they knew about the alien matter, the better the Nomai's chances of survival.
